Introduction

Kim Dong-young, popularly known as Doyoung, is a South Korean singer, actor, and musical theatre actor under SM Entertainment. Best known as a member of the boy group NCT and its sub-units NCT U, NCT 127, and NCT DOJAEJUNG, he debuted on April 9, 2016 with the digital single "The 7th Sense". He later made his official solo debut with the album "Youth" in April of 2024.

Prior to debuting, Doyoung was introduced through the SM trainee team SM Rookies and even appeared on Disney Channel Korea's "The Mickey Mouse Club".
